rules: Deleting a value in a POL file first forgets any value and marker for it. Unless it is already queued, a '**del.<name>' marker with the number 32 is then added, as Microsoft does. (PolicyPlus/PolicySource.vb:92)
Forgetting a value in a POL file removes both its value record and its deletion marker, so it returns to Not configured. (PolicyPlus/PolicySource.vb:99)

Setting a value in a POL file replaces any earlier record of the same value with the new data and kind. An existing deletion marker is not removed; the value record wins when the file is read. (PolicyPlus/PolicySource.vb:105)
Clearing a key in a POL file forgets every value and marker in the key, and adds a '**delvals.' marker, so the key is in the state Key cleared. (PolicyPlus/PolicySource.vb:183)

Clearing a key in a POL file forgets the stored record of every value in it, so those values no longer hold data. The clearing marker it leaves makes every value in that key count as Queued for deletion, until a real value is set for it; they do not read as Not configured. (PolicyPlus/PolicySource.vb:183)

Setting a value in a REG file puts the key and value in the file, creating the key's record if no non-removal record exists, and replacing a same-named value, so the value is in the state Configured. (PolicyPlus/RegFile.vb:226)

Deleting a value in a REG file does nothing if the key is already marked for removal. Otherwise the value is replaced by a removal mark, so it is in the state Queued for deletion. (PolicyPlus/RegFile.vb:240)
Clearing a key in a REG file replaces the key's record, with all its values, by a whole-key removal mark, so the key is in the state Key cleared. (PolicyPlus/RegFile.vb:248)

In the hexadecimal number box, typed text is read as an unsigned hex number. If it is too large to read as a 64-bit number, or larger than the box's maximum (4294967295 for a 32-bit DWord), the box takes the maximum. When typed text is confirmed in hexadecimal mode, it is read as a hex number and the box is redisplayed as the resulting value; in decimal mode the standard number box check applies. (PolicyPlus/EditPolNumericData.vb:33)
